'''''Koh-Lanta: La Légende''''' is the seventh special season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'' and the twenty-seventh season overall. It was broadcast on TF1 from August 24 to December 14, 2021.

This season featured twenty of the show's most iconic [[Returning Players|former contestants]] to commemorate its 20th anniversary. 

Initially, [[Claude Dartois]] defeated [[Laurent Maistret]] in a 9-4 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]]. However, due to accusations of both the finalists (among several others) cheating by means of stealing food from the production's base of operations, neither was awarded the title of Sole Survivor. Production instead donated the €100,000 grand prize to the Bertrand-Kamal Foundation in remembrance of ''[[Koh-Lanta: Les 4 Terres|Les 4 Terres]]'' castaway [[Bertrand-Kamal Loudrhiri|Bertrand-Kamal Loudhiri]], who passed away during his respective season's broadcast from pancreatic cancer.<ref>https://www.huffingtonpost.fr/divertissement/article/koh-lanta-la-legende-ce-que-l-on-sait-des-tricheries-avant-la-finale_189807.html</ref><ref>https://www.realityblurred.com/realitytv/2021/12/koh-lanta-la-legende-no-winner/</ref> 

==Production==
The production flew in four alternates for this season, consisting of two men and two women: 
* [[Loïc Riowal|Loïc]] ({{S2|25fr}}) and [[Sandro Gonzalez Schena|Sandro]] ({{S2|20fr}}).
*[[Béatrice Kabore|Béatrice]] ({{S2|23fr}}) and another undisclosed person.<br /> 
Loïc entered the game following [[Freddy Boucher|Freddy]]'s evacuation during [[Koh-Lanta: La Légende Episode 1|Episode 1]].<ref>https://www.programme-tv.net/news/tv/281738-koh-lanta-all-stars-2021-decouvrez-lidentite-des-aventuriers-remplacants-de-cette-saison/</ref>

==Twists/Changes==
* '''[[Returning Players/Koh-Lanta|Legends]]:''' Twenty former ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'' castaways return for another chance at the [[Sole Survivor]] title.
* '''[[Battle of the Sexes]]:''' At the start of the game, the castaways are divided into two [[Tribe|tribes]] based on gender. Those tribes don't have any color, flag, or [[buff]].
* '''[[Double Tribal Council]]:''' In the first two episodes, both tribes attend [[Tribal Council]] to each vote out one person. In both occurrences, they compete separately for individual immunity in two different challenges, with both the first and second-place finishers earning immunity in each challenge. The first-place finishers also gain an additional power to be used at the next Tribal Council:
** For the first Tribal Council, they can give an [[Extra Vote]] to a castaway on the opposite tribe.
** For the second Tribal Council, they can give immunity to a member of the opposite tribe after the votes have been cast.
* '''Penalty Vote after Challenge:''' In the individual Immunity Challenges of the first two episodes, the castaways that finish in the last two places receive a penalty vote against them at the next Tribal Council. Penalty votes do not extend through a revote.
* '''[[Redemption Island (international twist)|Isle of the Banished]]:''' After departing Tribal Council, the voted out castaways are given the choice to permanently leave the game or go into the unknown for a chance to come back. If they choose the latter option, they are taken to the Isle of the Banished, a small island with little resources. The residents of the island compete in an elimination [[duel]] every three days until the [[merge]], where the last two castaways standing return to the main game.
* '''[[Tribe Switch]]:''' On Day 6, the men's and women's tribes are dissolved. A [[Reward Challenge]] is held, with the first phase being a relay race: starting with the two winners of the previous Immunity Challenge, each castaway picks a torch corresponding to another player, who becomes their tribemate and goes on to pick another torch. The Reward Challenge then continues with the two new tribes formed.
* '''Pre-merge Individual Challenge:''' On Day 12, an individual Reward Challenge is held. Two castaways per tribe could qualify for the final phase, with the first three finalists winning reward.
* '''Impromptu Tribal Council:''' On Day 13, Tribal Council is held immediately after the Immunity Challenge, at the challenge site.
* '''Replacement:''' Due to [[Freddy Boucher]] being [[Evacuation|evacuated]] before the first Tribal Council, [[Loïc Riowal]] entered the game on Day 2 to replace him.
* '''[[Ambassadors]]:''' At the merge, both tribes must appoint a castaway from the opposite tribe to attend the ambassadors meeting, where their purpose is to directly eliminate a castaway from the game. If the ambassadors do not agree on a name, one of the two regular ambassadors is eliminated by a rock draw.
** '''Secret Ambassadors:''' : Following the last Duel of the Banished, both winners of the challenge joined the Ambassadors as Secret Ambassadors. Unbeknownst to the other castaways, they can then participate in the decision of eliminating a castaway from the game and they will then joined the merged tribe.
* '''[[Tied Destinies (twist)|Tied Destinies]]:''' On Day 23, the ten remaining castaways are divided into five pairs by a rock draw. Until the next Tribal Council, the fate of each contestant is linked to their partner: the challenges are competed by pairs, and the person voted out at Tribal Council causes their partner's demise.

==Trivia==
*With this season, [[Christelle Gauzet]] and [[Jade Handi]] currently hold the record for the largest gap between appearances in two different seasons (including special seasons), with 18 seasons.
**Meanwhile, [[Clémence Castel]] and [[Coumba Baradji]] currently hold the record for the largest gap between their first and most recent appearances (including special seasons), with 22 seasons.
*Although the "[[Redemption Island (international twist)|Isle of the Banished]]" twist is similar to the name of the twist used in ''Malaisie'', it works in a very different fashion (similar to Exile Island from ''Le Combat des Héros'').
*This was the first aired season in the [[Survivor (franchise)|''Survivor'' franchise]] that finished without an official winner, as [[Claude Dartois]] had his title revoked for cheating.
